subject: Hosted API pricing + model eligibility for Curelytics pilot
messages:
From: Ella Simmons <ella@curelytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: hosted API token IO rates + supported models

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this — Curelytics is evaluating a short pilot to add generative summaries and extraction to our clinical notes pipeline. Before we kick off a POC, procurement needs a clear per-1M token rate split (input vs output) for your hosted API and a short list of supported model families (and which are recommended for low-latency production).

For context: our POC will generate ~10M tokens / month (rough estimate), mostly short prompts (200-600 tokens) and long outputs for summary (up to ~1,500 tokens). Can you also confirm:
- Any standard pilot/intro discounts you offer?
- Whether quantized variants are available on hosted and how that affects rates/latency?
- Any model availability SLA we should know about for hosted (region: US)?

I've attached a short SOW and our estimated usage profile. We need the numbers for procurement by EOD Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to the breakout.

Best,
Ella Simmons
Head of ML, Curelytics
ella@curelytics.com

Attachments: Curelytics_POC_SOW.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ella Simmons <ella@curelytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: hosted API token IO rates + supported models

Hi Ella — great to hear from you and thanks for the SOW. Below is a concise baseline we can share with procurement; I'm also attaching our current hosted ratecard for detail.

Baseline hosted IO pricing (per 1M tokens) — US region (list prices):
- redwood-base-7b: input $0.40 / 1M, output $0.80 / 1M
- redwood-instruct-13b: input $0.70 / 1M, output $1.40 / 1M
- redwood-chat-35b: input $1.50 / 1M, output $3.00 / 1M

Notes:
- Quantized hosted variants (q8/q4) are available for the 7b and 13b families; typical unit-rate reduction is ~15–25% vs full-precision (depends on model/config). Latency impact: quantized 13b generally adds ~10–20ms for generation at mid lengths; still within low-latency bounds for most web requests.
- Recommended starting point for Curelytics POC: redwood-instruct-13b (good balance of quality and token cost for long-form summaries). If you prioritize cost and can accept slightly lower quality, the quantized redwood-base-7b is a common pilot path.
- Pilot discount: we can offer a promotional 20% discount off list IO rates for the first 3 months (applies to hosted usage only). The promo covers up to 50M cumulative tokens across the pilot period and requires a short MSA addendum (one page).
- Commit pricing / Dedicated discussions: we can provide additional tiered discounts with a monthly commit (DMR/Reserved capacity). I can put together a 10M/month commit example if helpful.

Attachments: redwood-hosted-ratecard-2028Q4.pdf (pdf) — includes full model roster, limits, and regional availability.

If that looks good I can draft a brief pilot proposal and the addendum for procurement. Want me to include an estimated monthly cost for 10M tokens under the 20% pilot?

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Principal Sales — Hosted API
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ella Simmons <ella@curelytics.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 13:18:00 -0800

Hi Marissa — thanks, that breakdown is exactly what procurement needed. A couple quick clarifications before I share:

1) For the 10M tokens/month example, can you send an estimated monthly spend number using the 13b recommended model under the 20% pilot?
2) Do the quantized variants have any additional limitations (e.g., max sequence length or function-calling support)?
3) Can we get the short MSA addendum text to loop into our legal review?

If you can send those before EOD Friday that would keep us on track.

Best,
Ella

Team — forwarding the thread with Curelytics. They asked for:
- a 10M/month estimate under the 20% pilot promo
- confirmation about quantized variant limits and MSA addendum text

My suggested response:
- Provide a line item monthly estimate for redwood-instruct-13b at projected 10M tokens (IO split assumed 30% input / 70% output). With list rates that comes to: list ~$11,200 / month -> pilot price (20% off) ~$8,960 / month. (Round and show per-token calc in the pilot quote.)
- Quantized 13b: supported on hosted in US, max sequence length same as full precision (8k), function-calling supported but recommend testing for your SOW since extreme edge cases can diverge.
- I'll attach the one-page addendum draft for legal.

Can you confirm the pilot discount (20%) is okay to commit to for up to 50M tokens across 3 months? Ben — any objections on MSA addendum language or billing flow? Aditya — please confirm model availability for hosted q4 deploy and if we should propose the 13b quantized variant as default for cost-sensitive runs.

Thanks — I want to send the procurement-ready note back to Ella by EOD today.

Marissa
